The classifier now covers every task today's sessions worked on, including the 10/15 folders and one from 10/13. Across the 15 tasks that turned up it counts 10 done and 5 waiting. Nothing new needed closing: the 10/15 tasks had already landed. `node Server/task-closeout.mjs 2026-10-16 --sessions` prints the per-session lines and counts.

Sessions are matched to tasks by session id or agent name. Four of the 19 sessions have no task: both `assistant-fast` sessions and the two `clarity-*` sessions.

**Per session**
- **Done:** `helper-live-stream`, `helper-remote-tools`, `helper-live-present`, `helper-page-instance`, `helper-tool-collapse`, `helper-page-subpages`, `mastermind-voice-20261015`, `mastermind-live-feed`, `mastermind-live-today`, and `mastermind-task-closeout`.
- **Waiting on a snooze:** `helper-handover-query`, until 2026-10-18 (set by `mastermind-voice-20261016`).
- **Waiting on the next question:** `mastermind-voice-opus` and `mastermind-voice-today`. Both reported idle and open on purpose, so they are not blocked on anyone.
- **Still active:** `mastermind-voice-20261016`.
- **Waiting, label probably wrong:** session `730e8a7b` (`mastermind-repo-slim`, from 10/13) shows "waiting on the owner", because the task loop escalated it to the card. Its own last log says it stood down, so that label is probably wrong. I left it open rather than closing it.

I tightened the "finished" rule so it now needs the agent's last substantive log line to be a done report. This stop …
